description: Documentation page describing the `Frame` class in Playwright, including its lifecycle events, methods, and usage examples across multiple programming languages. It details how to interact with frames within a browser context, such as navigating, evaluating scripts, manipulating DOM elements, and handling frame events.

methods.name: waitForNavigation
methods.description: Waits for the frame to navigate to a new URL. Useful for detecting navigation caused by actions within the frame, such as clicking links or using the History API. Supports multiple language-specific implementations and options such as URL pattern matching, wait until conditions, and timeout settings. Deprecated in favor of `waitForURL` due to inherent race conditions.

methods.name: waitForSelector
methods.description: Waits for an element matching the selector to satisfy a specified state (e.g., visible, hidden). Can be used across navigations, with support for selectors, state options, timeouts, and strict mode. Preferred over direct actions for waiting conditions.

methods.name: waitForTimeout
methods.description: Pauses execution for a specified number of milliseconds. Should only be used for debugging; not recommended for production tests due to flakiness.

methods.name: waitForURL
methods.description: Waits for the frame to navigate to a URL matching the given pattern. Supports options such as waitUntil conditions and timeout. Recommended over the deprecated `waitForNavigation` for more reliable navigation detection.
